name: recall-mcp
description: Query your ReCall saved-URL corpus from inside Claude Desktop using natural language.
long_description: Exposes your ReCall saved-URL library as MCP tools: semantic search, RAG-style Q&A over your saved pages, and a tag-grouped library overview. Requires a ReCall account and a refresh token from ReCall → Settings → Connect to other apps.

tools.name: recall_search
tools.description: Search your saved URLs by semantic similarity.

tools.name: recall_ask
tools.description: Ask a question answered from your saved URLs (RAG Q&A over your corpus).

tools.name: recall_list_saved
tools.description: List all URLs saved in your ReCall library.

recall_refresh_token.title: ReCall refresh token
recall_refresh_token.description: Your ReCall token, from ReCall → Settings → Connect to other apps.
